brief_rationale: Grade 5: The model met all 8 responsibility-chain items with no errors. It correctly identified postpartum headache with gestational hypertension/preeclampsia risk as urgent, screened danger signs, gave immediate action thresholds, and coordinated family execution. All 4 high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact: adapted communication to anxious family, navigated real-world constraints (baby care, elder opposition), discovered hidden states (BP values, medication), and achieved safe bounded closure with teach-back verification.
